'''Naval Command''', also known as '''Supreme Naval Command''',<ref name="The Star Wars Sourcebook">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> '''High Command''',<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> and the '''Imperial Star Fleet Command''',<ref name="The Constancia Affair">"[[The Constancia Affair]]"</ref> was the command structure of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. It was reformed from the [[Naval Command (Galactic Republic)|Naval Command]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and may have been related to the [[Admiralty (Imperial)/Legends|Admiralty]].

It consisted of four branches: [[Line Branch]], [[Flight Branch]], [[Fleet Support Branch]] and [[Support Service Branch]].<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

Naval Command can sometimes play direct roles in various military operations should they be considered high-enough of a priority. A notable example was with the events at the planet [[Constancia/Legends|Constancia]], where they were directly involved in the subjugation of the race due to their [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] powers, and also ordered for a contingent to immediately intercept the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="The Constancia Affair" />
